mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account_lifecycle_outbox WHERE ((status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND retry_count < max_retry_count AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND processing_at <= #{staleBefore})) ORDER BY next_retry_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE account_lifecycle_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', processing_at = #{now}, processing_by = #{worker}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND ((status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND retry_count < max_retry_count AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND processing_at <= #{staleBefore}))
